question: 固定r026网络、输入、初始化和深度，仅将全批量SGD学习率eta从0.02降至0.005，检验逐层最慢冻结时间与相加全核冻结时间对真实半损失步数的两倍内预测。

recipe.target: raw=x0+0.5*x0*x1; y=(raw-mean)/RMS; same x/y for all cells
recipe.architecture: depth hidden Linear+SiLU then scalar Linear head; all Linear no bias, no LN, no residual
recipe.initialization: hidden layer l seed=init_seed+10000*l, normal*sqrt(2/fan_in); head seed=init_seed+900000, normal/sqrt(width); common prefixes and head shared across depths

definitions.J_l: output Jacobian w.r.t. parameter group l
definitions.frozen_t50: first integer t with sum_i energy_i*(1-eta*lambda_i)^(2t)<=0.5, exact eigenspectrum search up to 2^60; null energy >=0.5 means unreachable
definitions.t_slow: max_l frozen_t50(K_l), infinite if any group unreachable
definitions.t_actual: first integer t=1..4096 with loss(t)<=loss(0)/2; otherwise right-censored >4096
definitions.parameter_groups: one weight matrix per hidden layer plus head; head is included in both candidates
definitions.eigenvalue_rule: lambda <= 1e-12*max(lambda_max,1e-30) treated as zero; negative lambda < -1e-10*max(lambda_max,1e-30) invalid; eta*lambda_max>=2 unstable
definitions.r_t: f_t(x)-y; a common output residual, no separate hidden-layer loss
definitions.q_l: r_t^T K_l r_t/(r_t^T r_t), a local residual direction rate
definitions.layer_residual_energy: (V_l^T r_t)^2 in layer output-space eigenbasis; not layer loss

predictions.text: 最慢参数层仍系统性高估真实半损失时间：12/12配对比值>2，且每个深度至少2/3失败。
predictions.criterion: 全12 cell均 ratio>2；每个深度失败数>=2。

predictions.text: 相加全核在降低eta后仍保持多数两倍内：至少10/12 cell满足0.5<=t_sum/t_actual<=2，且每个深度至少2/3满足。
predictions.criterion: 总计通过>=10/12，且四个深度各通过>=2/3。

decision_rules.units: 4 depth recipes x 3 init seeds = 12 training cells; seeds are repeats
decision_rules.censoring: candidate unreachable with finite actual is fail; actual>4096 and candidate<=2048 is fail; other censored pairs unresolved; >=2 failures refutes depth, otherwise >=2 passes supports depth
decision_rules.scope: development only; no coefficient fit or unseen-depth validation; depth changes parameter count and initial function
decision_rules.limits: K=sum K_l and fixed-kernel recursion are known identities; spectra depend on parameterization; kernel drift and residual-direction changes are not intervened
decision_rules.statistics: all seed ratios and same-seed adjacent-depth differences; within-depth t95 intervals only all finite; initialization uncertainty only, no pooled iid p value
decision_rules.failure: diverged or invalid spectrum unresolved, preserve errors, no success overwrite
decision_rules.eta_branch: 若eta*lambda_max>=2则冻结候选记为unstable并判失败；本轮预测所有初始核均稳定。

execution.source_pinning: manifest pins run.py, analysis.py, verify.py; all must match one ancestor commit before training
execution.resume: existing JSON and NPZ contract/hash must match; orphan NPZ is error
execution.budget: CPU small tensors, under 20 minutes; no network/GPU/API/outside writes
